text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"MF-007","evidence":[{"kind":"title_block","ref":"material","page":1,"quote":"Polyurethene"},{"kind":"title_block","ref":"heat_treatment","page":1,"quote":"HARDENED 40-45 HRC"}],"comment":"The title block specifies the material as \"Polyurethene\" but also calls for \"HARDENED 40-45 HRC\"; polyurethane is a polymer that cannot be heat-treated to a Rockwell C hardness, making these two fields contradictory. The designer must correct either the material or remove the impossible heat treatment specification.","recommended_correction":"Remove the heat treatment callout if the part is polyurethane, or change the material field if a hardenable metal was intended."}]}
